scope: Live Suite 11.3.42 Arrangement transport ownership; no Session onset certification
conclusion: No available property-only interface proves exclusive transport ownership across all external actions.

sources.authority: Official LOM property/function prior art, not a build-pinned Python callback ordering guarantee
Current official cross-check; includes post-Live11 features, not Live11 runtime evidence
Unofficial decompiled Live11 transport prior art; not normative or certification

repositoryEvidence.executor: MainThreadExecutor serializes application commands, not all native UI/MIDI/Link/audio actors; drain executes up to eight commands per scheduled task.
repositoryEvidence.curatedListeners: LomListenerManager observes is_playing, record_mode and session_record but not current_song_time, loop, loop_start, loop_length, back_to_arranger, arrangement_overdub or session_automation_record. Missing registrations are skipped/logged, not a proof of supported ownership observation.
repositoryEvidence.dynamicListeners: LiveEventSubscriptionManager observes playing_slot_index/fired_slot_index and recording fallbacks; discrete publication compares the current reread with previous state, so it is not an action log. Parameter callbacks are deliberately coalesced.
repositoryEvidence.transportSetter: system_commands.set_playing calls start_playing/stop_playing and verifies a later boolean; it does not preserve ownership, source identity or exact seek-to-start semantics.
repositoryEvidence.sentinelWarning: Existing playing_clip_state labels -2 as arrangement, whereas the public Track LOM describes -2 as Session Clip Stop fired and -1 as Arrangement recording without Session clip. Never use that label alone as Arrangement source proof.

callbackClassification.condition: Every required callback must be available, lossless and delivered before the protected stop mutation. Latch loss directly inside the raw Python callback, even if a subsequent read has reverted; do not rely on curated/coalesced network events. This host ordering is not proven by the public documentation or simulator.
notAnOriginProof: current_song_time values during advancement vs forward seek
same-value seek or start/retrigger with no state transition
external source intent when its visible properties remain unchanged
callbackClassification.pollingOnlyLimit: Polling or final snapshot equality misses any on/off or stop/start takeover completed between samples; elapsed time and monotonic position tolerances are heuristics, not authority.
callbackClassification.unsupportedRequiredProperty: Fail before any transport mutation; do not omit an observer or substitute a default value.

runner.preflight: Use the existing runner-owned process/profile guard. Refuse any pre-existing Live process, including user PID 56060; never install, attach, mutate or kill it.
runner.version: Record exact Live/Python/OS build and introspected listener availability. Live12 and unknown builds are unsupported.
runner.fixture: Fresh disposable unsaved Set, one ordinary audio track with deterministic Arrangement clip over beats 0..32, one Session clip on that track for override-only tests, no armed tracks, all recording flags false, loop false, no automation, fixed tempo. Record exact bridge references and canonical paths.
runner.actors: Separate test-only owner probe and independent injector on the runner-owned host. Injector must not share the owner's suppression flag. Exercise both independent Python/M4L control and runner-owned UI/MIDI actions; Python-only injection cannot establish UI callback equivalence.
runner.probe: Non-publishing test instrumentation only. Register raw known-property callbacks before mutation; callbacks append bounded samples and immediately latch invalidation without scheduling/debounce. No production playback command, success token or audio publication is enabled.
runner.startSemanticsExperiment: Compare setting current_song_time followed by start_playing versus continue_playing with start_time deliberately different. Document which primitive starts from the requested beat without changing the insert marker; never assume start_playing means continue from current position.
runner.orderingExperiment: Log injector.before_call, raw_callback_enter, raw_callback_exit, injector.after_call, owner.before_stop_guard and owner.after_stop_call with monotonic nanoseconds, main-thread identity and sequential counter. Test stop requests immediately after actions and after zero, one and two scheduled ticks. Log registration/removal failures.
runner.overflow: Any dropped event, record overflow, unavailable observer, inconsistent thread/order, timeout or malformed trace means UNKNOWN/FAIL, never ownership confirmed.
runner.trace: Carry traceId/correlationId/causationId/passId/probeGeneration through runner, injector, callbacks and terminal report. Record queued/started/progress/completed/failed/cancelled plus duration; bounded sanitized metadata only, no PCM, secrets or arbitrary LOM properties.
runner.cleanup: Remove every installed callback in reverse order and verify no further probe callbacks. A separate runner janitor may stop/discard only its own disposable process/Set; distinguish janitor cleanup from owner stop. Clear timers and generation on disconnect/deletion/cancellation. Never cleanup a user process.
runner.verdict: Observations can falsify synchronous/lossless ordering assumptions but finite successful trials cannot create an undocumented universal action-origin guarantee. Result remains UNVERIFIED unless a host-native generation/CAS API with the stated contract is independently established.

cases.assert: Capture ordinary current_song_time callback cadence; conservative invalidate-on-any-position may lose immediately and is not useful owned playback.

cases.action: Independent current_song_time write to beat 7 while playing
cases.assert: Position-change callback and loss ordering recorded; never stop after loss.

cases.action: Independent write to beat 9 and to a small forward delta within one normal notification interval
cases.assert: Large displacement may be recognizable; small forward displacement has no documented origin classifier.

cases.action: Independent write of the exact current_song_time value
cases.assert: Record whether an event exists; no event is permitted by a value-change-only contract.

cases.action: Independent start_playing, continue_playing and is_playing=True while already running, with insert marker equal and unequal to current position
cases.assert: Determine state/position changes; no equal-value action notification is documented.

cases.action: Independent stop_playing then continue_playing/start_playing in one native task, then in separate ticks
cases.assert: If both raw callbacks precede the guard, latch lost on the first and never recover. A final playing=True snapshot cannot prove no takeover.

cases.action: Fire the fixture Session clip, fire Clip Stop, return to Arrangement, and repeat a same-slot fire; these are takeover injections only
cases.assert: Record fired/playing indices and Song/Track back_to_arranger callbacks; any takeover latches loss. Do not infer actual Session sounding onset or Arrangement source from -2.

cases.action: Toggle each of record_mode, arrangement_overdub, session_record and session_automation_record on then off in one task and across ticks; fixture tracks stay unarmed
cases.assert: All four callbacks required; first unsafe notification latches loss even if all flags are false again.

cases.action: Toggle loop on/off and change/restore loop_start/loop_length within one task and across ticks
cases.assert: Any loop takeover latches loss; equal final loop snapshot is insufficient.

cases.action: Independent nudge, tempo, punch and Link-mode changes using supported known controls
cases.assert: Unknown/unobservable mode or timing change fails closed; do not normalize it into ordinary progress.

cases.action: Injection before start guard, during owner native-call scope, immediately after start and immediately before stop guard
cases.assert: Test that blanket self-mutation suppression cannot mask independent actor events; unknown interleaving cannot issue or redeem a token.

cases.action: Disconnect, cancel, delete target and simulate registration failure before/after probing
cases.assert: No owner stop after loss, no leaking callbacks/timers, no success token, capability remains disabled.

minimumApiChange.authority: Host-native authority, not a Python counter fed only by property notifications
minimumApiChange.generation: Monotonic transport/source mutation generation covering every UI/MIDI/Link/control-surface seek/start/retrigger/stop/source/record/loop/mode action, including same-value actions; natural progression alone must not increment it.
minimumApiChange.atomicStart: Native transaction rechecks stopped, all recording-off, exact Set/targets and Arrangement source constraints; seeks/continues and returns ownerId/passId/generation plus exact source generation. External actions inside the transaction must be serialized or invalidate its result.
minimumApiChange.atomicStop: Host compare-and-stop(ownerId, generation, sourceGeneration) checks authority and performs stop in the same native critical section; a mismatched/lost token produces stopped=false without mutation.
minimumApiChange.alternative: Explicitly weaken the product contract to best-effort playback without stop ownership, or enforce an independently proven exclusive host actor environment. Neither is the current safe listening ownership contract.
